featured_reviews.review_text:
25th April 2025:
Extremely disappointing experience with Magma General Insurance.

Despite submitting all required documents for policy endorsement after vehicle ownership transfer, the company has been unnecessarily delaying and refusing to process the endorsement, citing contradictory and illogical reasons.

On one hand, they are not honouring the claim stating the policy was not endorsed, and on the other hand, they are refusing to endorse the policy even after claim closure, creating a completely unavoidable situation for the customer and putting customer on a very high risk.

This is not just poor service it reflects a lack of accountability and basic understanding of customer risk. Because of their inaction, the policy remains in the previous owner’s name, exposing the current owner to serious complications in case of any future claims, including third-party liabilities.
Multiple follow-ups emails only result in template responses with no resolution or ownership.

I strongly advise potential customers to think twice or thrice before choosing this insurer, especially if you expect timely support or basic administrative services like policy endorsement and cooperation from the Insurer. There employees do wrongful commitments. One surveyer said he will turn-up by EOD to survey the vehicle, two days later I had call him to take the status. Every alternate day I had to follow up for the status though there was no status. There is  NOT a single instance where the surveyor has called me and provided the status of which I followed with him. They have a 15 days TAT to process the request of claim, today it's been like 23rd days, no resolution either on claim or endorsement which keep the customer on a very high risk and it is a complete disappointment. There GRO is also not effective and customer centric but having template response and provide illogical reasons for delay which cannot be a accepted by a person with rationale mind.

A company that cannot handle a simple endorsement request raises serious concerns about how they would handle critical claims. Choose responsible insurer who might be a bit costlier than this insurer but they will give you peace of mind and NOT the chaos that Magma General Insurance does to its customers.

I am in the process of escalating this matter before the right forum as such deliberate careless or reckless bahavior of the Magma General Insurance cannot be tolerated.

#PoorService #BoycottMagmaGeneralInsurance
#IRDAI
#CIOINS

The Magma and it's GRO team is still taking whole lot unreasonable time for the completing the endorsement process of the vehicle. Please note that Magma got the vehicle inspected on 25 April 2026 as per my tough conversation with GRO team and inspection report shared with me on 28th April 2026 with requisition of some documents which I have provided to Magma and it's GRO on 28th April 2026 on which Magma has replied that they will update in next 2 days. Also, note that the Magma's GRO stated on 24th April 2026 that the claim will be closed by 27th April 2026 which I have sought the update that they have not provided to me the update yet. It is interesting that for the first time Magma's surveyor contacted me, he sent an email asking documents for the claim processing on 26th April 2026 and in the email he has stated that he got the survey done of the vehicle at the service centre which in reality he never turned on till the time my vehicle was there that day.
I didn't understand this whole delay caused by Magma and putting the customer on ambiguities and apparent risk which I have clarified that Magma will be held liable fully.

featured_reviews.name: Himansh Kaushik
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst experience. Worst car insurance company ever. Their surveyors and claim managers are all corrupt here in Agra, UP  especially Surveyor Tarun Raj Sharma, Mahesh and Claims Manager Ankur Saxena. They never approve your insurance and find unnecessary flaws just to reduce their company’s expense, complete their personal targets, create a goodwill in front of their company or any personal grudge they hold with the customers. Their senior managers are also not capable enough to take strict actions timely as they are also corrupt. On 06th Oct 2025, my car was hit both in front and back, and as soon as the process of claim started, their Surveyor Tarun Raj Sharma called me over phone and asked to remove the back damage of car from the application or else he will not approve even the front damage. He was acting like he was making a business deal with me and indirectly asking for bribe for approving the claim. He didn’t approve the valid damages even after providing the videos, photos and CCTV footage of the incident. Their manager Ankur Saxena just follows whatever their Surveyor Tarun Raj Sharma says without verifying anything.
Another thing, they never gave me my Towing/Crane amount of ₹1500/- even after producing the bill of it on the same day of claim and confirmed by the Carne Service agency and Hyundai workshop agency both. When i inquired, their Claims Manager Ankur Saxena gave me a senseless excuse that you have not used the crane/towing facility but driven the car which was not even in a condition to drive as the front part of the car  was completely damaged, I told them that i have given the bill of it, you can inquire from the crane facility provider whether i used the crane service or not, then they negated that and ate that amount as the company had disbursed the amount but they never gave it to me.
This is a complete FRAUD company, do not fell into their trap of having less amount of policy. The company should definitely take serious actions on these corrupt employees and my case should be resolved as i have not been provided any assistance till now.

featured_reviews.name: Apurba Maiti
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very bad experience. After repairing on 09 May , The insurance amount not paid by the company. Today on 12 Sep I have received the amount. I am having doubt about the official efficiency and willingness to work. As it was told within 10 working days amount will be paid . But it took 4 months.
If I have not paid the amount to the repair agency , they would have imposed penalty for non paying . Over that if it have left in Gurage ,they will charge for occupying the Gurage for so long.
